question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        oi.product_id,
        oi.seller_id,
        oi.price,
        oi.freight_value,
        p.product_category_name
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) as distinct_customers,
        SUM(price - freight_value) as total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as distinct_orders
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY product_category_name, seller_id
),
review_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_category_name,
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 5 THEN 1 END) as five_star_ratings
    FROM olist_order_reviews r
    JOIN olist_orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY product_category_name, seller_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        om.product_category_name,
        om.seller_id,
        om.distinct_customers,
        om.total_profit,
        om.distinct_orders,
        COALESCE(rc.five_star_ratings, 0) as five_star_ratings
    FROM order_metrics om
    LEFT JOIN review_counts rc ON om.product_category_name = rc.product_category_name AND om.seller_id = rc.seller_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        distinct_customers,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC) as rn
    FROM combined
),
ranked_profit AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        total_profit,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY total_profit DESC) as rn
    FROM combined
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        distinct_orders,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY distinct_orders DESC) as rn
    FROM combined
),
ranked_five_star AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        five_star_ratings,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY five_star_ratings DESC) as rn
    FROM combined
)
SELECT 
    'highest_distinct_customers' as achievement_type,
    c.product_category_name,
    c.seller_id,
    c.distinct_customers as value,
    'highest number of distinct customer unique IDs' as description
FROM ranked_customers c
WHERE c.rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'highest_profit' as achievement_type,
    p.product_category_name,
    p.seller_id,
    ROUND(p.total_profit, 2) as value,
    'highest profit (price minus freight value)' as description
FROM ranked_profit p
WHERE p.rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'highest_distinct_orders' as achievement_type,
    o.product_category_name,
    o.seller_id,
    o.distinct_orders as value,
    'highest number of distinct orders' as description
FROM ranked_orders o
WHERE o.rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'most_five_star_ratings' as achievement_type,
    f.product_category_name,
    f.seller_id,
    f.five_star_ratings as value,
    'most 5-star ratings' as description
FROM ranked_five_star f
WHERE f.rn = 1
ORDER BY product_category_name, achievement_type
